title: Graph description
description: One graph, described by its type and the values that type accepts. Text is plain text: control, line-break, text-direction and invisible characters are not accepted. A color is a color name (black, gray, red, orange, green, blue, purple, brown) in any case, or a hex code such as #0072b2. The package's validator also checks what this schema cannot: tag characters, rare variation selectors and broken surrogates in text; values that determine one another must agree within 1%; ranges must have their minimum below their maximum; a term given only when another term has a stated value; type-specific rules such as points inside the axes; and at most 10000 values in one description. Schema and validator agree on the JSON form of a description.

anyOf.title: Number line
anyOf.description: A number line: one axis from its min to its max, negative, positive or across zero, with ticks, an arrowhead at each end unless turned off, and optionally marked points (at most 100), custom tick labels and a label for the line.

type.description: The graph type: which kind of graph the description draws.

version.description: The schema version the description is written for. Leave it out for the current version, 1.

title.description: A title shown above the graph, as plain text, at most 200 characters. In the drawing, a title longer than three lines is cut short with “…”; the text alternative states it whole.

lineColor.description: The color of a line: the number line itself, a figure's outline, or one series of a line graph. A color name or a hex code such as #0072b2.

lineLabel.description: A label for a line: the number line itself, or one series of a line graph, as plain text, at most 200 characters. In the drawing, a label longer than two lines is cut short with “…”: below a number line, or in a line graph's legend. The text alternative states it whole.

axis.description: The number line's axis: its range from min to max, and optionally its tick spacing and whether its ticks are labeled. max must be greater than min.

min.description: The lowest value on an axis: negative, zero or positive, whole or decimal, from -1000000000 to 1000000000, and below the axis's max.

max.description: The highest value on an axis: negative, zero or positive, whole or decimal, from -1000000000 to 1000000000, and above the axis's min by at least a billionth of the larger end's size (and at least 0.000000001).

tickSpacing.description: The distance between neighbouring ticks on an axis: greater than 0 and at most 2000000000, giving at most 100 ticks. Ticks fall at every whole multiple of it inside the range, so zero is always ticked when the range includes it, and an end that is not a multiple has no tick. When it is left out, the spacing is 1, 2 or 5 times a power of ten, chosen to give between 5 and 20 ticks on a range at least 0.001 wide (fewer on a narrower one), or coarser, down to two ticks, where the axis is drawn too short for its tick labels to stand apart.

showTickLabels.description: Whether an axis's ticks are labeled with their values; shown unless false. A label shows no more decimal places than the tick spacing needs.

leftArrow.description: Whether the number line's left end has an arrowhead, showing the line goes on; shown unless false. Without one, the line stops at its min.

rightArrow.description: Whether the number line's right end has an arrowhead, showing the line goes on; shown unless false. Without one, the line stops at its max.

points.description: The points marked on the graph, each at its position (its value on a number line, its x and y on a coordinate graph) and optionally with a label and a color. Points may share a position: each is drawn, and their labels are placed apart where the drawing has room.

items.description: One marked point: its value, and optionally its label and color.

value.description: A position on the number line, in the line's own numbers: where a point is marked, or the tick a custom label is written at. It must lie on the line's range, ends included; a custom label's value must be a tick.

label.description: A label for this one point, segment or measured object, as plain text, at most 200 characters. In the drawing, a long label is cut short with “…”; the text alternative states it whole.

color.description: The color of this one point, segment, bar or measured object: a color name or a hex code such as #0072b2.

tickLabels.description: Custom labels written at ticks in place of their values, at most 100: for example "start" at 0, or a blank at a tick to fill in. When two labels share a tick, the first is written. Hidden with the other tick labels when the axis's showTickLabels is false.

items.description: One custom tick label: the tick's value and the text written there.

value.description: A position on the number line, in the line's own numbers: where a point is marked, or the tick a custom label is written at. It must lie on the line's range, ends included; a custom label's value must be a tick.

text.description: The text written at a tick in place of its value, as plain text, at most 200 characters. An empty text leaves the tick unlabeled. In the drawing, a text wider than its tick's room is cut short with “…”, though never to fewer than a few letters, so on a densely ticked line neighbouring labels may touch; the text alternative states it whole.

anyOf.title: Ruler
anyOf.description: A ruler in centimeters or inches, drawn to scale with itself (not at true physical size), with whole units numbered from 0, and optionally an object lying along it from one mark to another, for "how long is it?" questions. A centimeter ruler is up to 30 cm long and an inch ruler up to 12 in.

type.description: The graph type: which kind of graph the description draws.

version.description: The schema version the description is written for. Leave it out for the current version, 1.

title.description: A title shown above the graph, as plain text, at most 200 characters. In the drawing, a title longer than three lines is cut short with “…”; the text alternative states it whole.

rulerUnit.description: The unit a ruler is marked in: centimeters or inches.

length.description: How many whole units a ruler is long: 1 to 30 for centimeters, 1 to 12 for inches.

smallestDivision.description: The smallest division an inch ruler is marked to; sixteenth when left out. Give it only when rulerUnit is "inches".

measuredObject.description: An object lying along the ruler, to be measured, drawn as a bar from its start mark to its end mark; its length is never written on the figure.

start.description: The ruler mark the object starts at, in the ruler's unit, as a decimal: a whole millimeter on a centimeter ruler (3.4), a multiple of the smallest division on an inch ruler (2.0625 for 2 1/16). Any mark from 0 to the ruler's length.

end.description: The ruler mark the object ends at, after its start, given as the start is.

label.description: A label for this one point, segment or measured object, as plain text, at most 200 characters. In the drawing, a long label is cut short with “…”; the text alternative states it whole.

color.description: The color of this one point, segment, bar or measured object: a color name or a hex code such as #0072b2.

anyOf.title: x,y,z coordinate graph
anyOf.description: A three-dimensional coordinate graph: an x-axis, a y-axis and a z-axis meeting at the origin (or, for a range without zero, at its end nearest zero), drawn in isometric projection, the same fixed view as cubes and cylinders: z straight up the page, x toward the lower left and y toward the lower right, each 30° below the horizontal, the three 120° apart. Each axis is drawn the same length whatever its range. Points (at most 1000) are plotted at their x, y and z, optionally with dashed guide lines to the x,y plane.

anyOf.title: Line graph
anyOf.description: A line graph: one or more series of values over the categories, each value a point and each series a line joining its points, with a legend when there is more than one series. Each series has its own color, point shape and dash pattern. Values may be negative. At most 100 categories and 6 series.

type.description: The graph type: which kind of graph the description draws.

version.description: The schema version the description is written for. Leave it out for the current version, 1.

title.description: A title shown above the graph, as plain text, at most 200 characters. In the drawing, a title longer than three lines is cut short with “…”; the text alternative states it whole.

categoryAxisLabel.description: A label for the axis that lists the categories, as plain text, at most 200 characters. In the drawing, a label longer than two lines is cut short with “…”; the text alternative states it whole.

valueAxisLabel.description: A label for the axis that shows the values, as plain text, at most 200 characters. In the drawing, a label longer than two lines is cut short with “…”; the text alternative states it whole.

valueScale.description: The value axis's scale: its minimum, maximum and tick interval, each optional. A part that is given is used exactly and never extended, and must include every value; a part left out is chosen to fit the data: the minimum is zero, or lower for a line graph's negative values, and the axis ends on a tick. maximum must be greater than minimum.

minimum.description: The lowest value on the value axis, from -1000000000 to 1000000000: 0, or at least 0.000000001 in size.

maximum.description: The highest value on the value axis, from -1000000000 to 1000000000: 0, or at least 0.000000001 in size; above the minimum by at least a billionth of the larger end's size.

tickInterval.description: The distance between neighbouring ticks on the value axis: greater than 0, dividing the scale into whole intervals, with at most 100 ticks.

categories.description: The categories, drawn in the order given: at least 1 and at most 100, each with a different name.

name.description: The category's name, as plain text, at most 200 characters. A long name wraps onto more lines.

series.description: The series, at least 1 and at most 6, each drawn as a line through one point per category. Without a lineColor, a series takes the default color for its position (the first series the first color, and so on); every series also has its own point shape and dash pattern, so series differ without color.

items.description: One series: its values, and optionally its label and line color.

values.description: One value per category, in the same order as the categories.

items.description: A category's value in this series, from -1000000000 to 1000000000.

lineLabel.description: A label for a line: the number line itself, or one series of a line graph, as plain text, at most 200 characters. In the drawing, a label longer than two lines is cut short with “…”: below a number line, or in a line graph's legend. The text alternative states it whole.

lineColor.description: The color of a line: the number line itself, a figure's outline, or one series of a line graph. A color name or a hex code such as #0072b2.

anyOf.title: Bar graph
anyOf.description: A bar graph: one bar per category, upright (the default) or across, its length in exact proportion to the category's value, from zero. Values are 0 or more. At most 100 categories.

anyOf.title: Pictograph
anyOf.description: A pictograph: one row of pictures per category (or one column, upright), each picture standing for a number of units, with a key such as "each apple = 2 students". A value that is not a whole number of pictures ends in one cropped picture. At most 100 categories and 400 pictures in all.

anyOf.title: Circle
anyOf.description: A circle drawn to scale from its radius, diameter or circumference (give one; any other given must agree within 1%). The radius, the diameter and the center can be drawn, and each measurement labeled with its value and unit or with custom text. Give one of radius, diameter or circumference; the others are worked out from it.

type.description: The graph type: which kind of graph the description draws.

version.description: The schema version the description is written for. Leave it out for the current version, 1.

title.description: A title shown above the graph, as plain text, at most 200 characters. In the drawing, a title longer than three lines is cut short with “…”; the text alternative states it whole.

lineColor.description: The color of a line: the number line itself, a figure's outline, or one series of a line graph. A color name or a hex code such as #0072b2.

radius.description: The distance from the center to the circle, from 0.001 to 1,000,000.

diameter.description: The distance across the circle through its center, twice the radius, from 0.002 to 2,000,000.

circumference.description: The distance around the circle, 2π times the radius, from 0.006 to 6,283,186.

showRadius.description: Whether the radius is drawn, from the center horizontally to the right.

showDiameter.description: Whether the diameter is drawn through the center; it never lies on the radius.

showCenter.description: Whether the center is marked with a point.

labelRadius.description: Whether the radius is labeled with its measurement; a labeled radius is drawn.

labelDiameter.description: Whether the diameter is labeled with its measurement; a labeled diameter is drawn.

labelCircumference.description: Whether the circumference is labeled with its measurement, next to the circle.

radiusLabelText.description: Text shown in place of the radius label, at most 200 characters, such as "r" or "?"; it also labels the radius. It replaces the whole label, unit included, so add the unit to the text if it should show. An empty text is a blank label, for example a space to fill in. Text too long to fit beside the figure is placed below it, and text longer than four lines is cut short with “…”. The text alternative still states the value.

diameterLabelText.description: Text shown in place of the diameter label, at most 200 characters, such as "r" or "?"; it also labels the diameter. It replaces the whole label, unit included, so add the unit to the text if it should show. An empty text is a blank label, for example a space to fill in. Text too long to fit beside the figure is placed below it, and text longer than four lines is cut short with “…”. The text alternative still states the value.

circumferenceLabelText.description: Text shown in place of the circumference label, at most 200 characters, such as "r" or "?"; it also labels the circumference. It replaces the whole label, unit included, so add the unit to the text if it should show. An empty text is a blank label, for example a space to fill in. Text too long to fit beside the figure is placed below it, and text longer than four lines is cut short with “…”. The text alternative still states the value.

unit.description: The unit of length shown after each measurement, such as cm, at most 20 characters. A unit with sentence punctuation is quoted in the text alternative.

anyOf.title: Square
anyOf.description: A square drawn to scale from its side length. One side or all four can be labeled with the length and unit or with custom text, and its right angles can be marked.
